documentation: THE single source of truth for which repository paths are machine-local and must
never be committed. Three consumers read this file and none of them keeps its own
Change the list here and run `npm run local-only:write`. CI fails if the .gitignore
managed block has drifted from this file, so the copies cannot silently diverge.
loadBearing is the other half of the guard. A path listed there is asserted to be
tracked and required. The checker refuses to run if any localOnly entry would match
a loadBearing path, which is the mistake that broke this repository on 2026-09-02:
scripts/ looks like tooling but CI invokes scripts/seed-portal.mjs and
scripts/verify-schema.mjs, so untracking it broke the supabase-integration job.

ROOT CAUSE, measured: in every case the files were committed FIRST and the .gitignore entry was added AFTERWARDS. A .gitignore rule has no effect on a file git already tracks, so each rule looked like a fix while doing nothing. See whyItLeaked on each entry. That is why the guard checks TRACKED files rather than trusting .gitignore.

docs/ is local-only by owner decision on 2026-09-05. It previously held three architecture decision records and a workflow specification; those were deleted on purpose and are not to be restored. They remain reachable in git history if ever needed.
